answer: An admission auction sells a limited number of entry slots each epoch, so fakes must outbid honest ones. A beacon publishes the clearing price, and each winning bid locks for 20 epochs. Prices climb like a glacier, slow and unstoppable. A sybil chasing 50 slots hits a spiral: each extra slot from one funder costs 1.5x the last, so 50 fakes cost 12,000 POA against a 2,000 POA reward. An honest agent buys one slot and keeps its earnings undiluted.
